requests.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: original AW2 exploration panorama. Input image1 is our own village landscape STYLE reference, image2 our own prop/NPC style reference only. Match warm Vietnamese-inspired red tile roofs, amber lanterns, jade bamboo, flowers, natural stone and rich crisp painted pixel/chibi game art. Elevated three-quarter top-down view, not eye-level. Exact1536x1024 opaque single complete landscape. Camera looks at a rich environment with several depth layers around a large clear traversable central space. VERY IMPORTANT source image rectangle x430..1110,y310..720 must remain flat unobstructed walkable paving/wood: NO buildings/roofs/steps/water/shelves/tall props/people/walls in that central rectangle. The entire central region is walkable with tiny flat flowers/moss/dirt allowed only; perspective should be shallow enough not to imply steep stairs on floor. Buildings/tall objects/scenery only outside that rectangle, particularly the outer quarters. Do NOT bake NPCs, quest hint, chest, well, crates or game interfaces/text into floor. No words/letters/logos/watermarks, no center vignette or border. Fill the full frame with rich authored environment, center floor still pleasantly textured with low flat detail. No empty white/matte background. Subject: a cozy old village pantry in the communal kitchen compound. Rich shelves of ceramic storage jars, neatly bundled herbs, rice sacks, timber rafters, warm paper lamps and a glimpse of jade bamboo outside at the upper side. Shadowed shelves recede around the top, left and right outer apron. Wood-and-terracotta floor in the clear central rectangle. No perspective front wall blocking view. Side passageways visually align at image x472,y512 (west) and1064,y512(east) but do not place doors on those points; those are flat unobstructed floor. Bottom apron shows low floral/courtyard fringe and a cutaway timber edge outside clear rectangle. Quiet, welcoming, slightly dusty, highly detailed coherent environment. Does not depict an activated flame.
